# The central-banks feed

Central banks (FRED and the Bank of Canada).

The economy module's public-sector central-banks pack (docs/guides/PUBLIC_SECTOR_GUIDE.md): Policy rates and the market series around them: the Federal Reserve's target range and effective rate, Treasury yields, the curve's slope, US inflation, unemployment and the Fed's balance sheet (FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), and the Bank of Canada's target rate, CORRA, Government of Canada yields and USD/CAD (Bank of Canada Valet). A bank's page shows its policy rate, its last move and its series; each series shows two years of history. Filled daily by the central-banks feed into the worldlake lake; FRED needs a free key in DRISHTI_FRED_API_KEY.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, Bank of Canada (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/) |
| Licence | [FRED API terms (the default series: US government works, public domain); Bank of Canada terms (free use with attribution)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html): redistributable with attribution |
| Attribution | Source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; Bank of Canada. |
| Notes | each source's terms are its entry in options.sources; a FRED series with a third-party copyright needs internal-only there |
| Lake | `worldlake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | weekdays at 18:15 (local time) |
| Pull | `central_banks.CentralBanksFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/central_banks.py); 0.6 s between requests, 3 retries |
| Keys | `api_key` from `${DRISHTI_FRED_API_KEY}` (optional) |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run central-banks --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run central-banks                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/central-banks/<date>/, load into worldlake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status central-banks             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [EXTERNAL_DATA.md](../../docs/guides/EXTERNAL_DATA.md).

## Data contract

### central-bank

Pack `central-banks`, kind `central-bank` (Central bank), table `central-bank`, key `BANK_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/central-banks/<date>/central-bank.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BANK_ID` | id | required | CBANK- and the bank's short id in the feed's YAML (FED, BOC). |
| `NAME` | text | required | The central bank's name. |
| `COUNTRY` | text | required | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the bank's country. |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional | The bank's country. |
| `CURRENCY` | text | optional | The ISO 4217 code of the bank's currency. |
| `WEBSITE` | text | optional | The bank's website. |
| `POLICY_RATE` | rate | optional | The latest value of the bank's policy-rate series (the Fed: the target range's upper limit; the Bank of Canada: the target for the overnight rate). |
| `POLICY_RATE_DATE` | date | optional | The date of that value. |
| `POLICY_SERIES` | id | optional | The rate-series page of the policy rate. |
| `LAST_MOVE_DATE` | date | optional | The first date the policy rate took its current value, within the history window; empty when it did not move in the window. |
| `LAST_MOVE_BP` | amount | optional | The size of that move: the new rate less the old one, in basis points (negative for a cut). |
| `POLICY_HISTORY` | record list | required | The policy rate by date over the window, oldest first (DATE, VALUE). |
| `SERIES` | record list | required | Every series of the bank the feed follows, one row each: RATE_SERIES, TITLE, LATEST, DATE, CHANGE, UNIT. |
| `PRESS` | id | optional | The bank's publisher page in the official-news pack (PRESS-<id>). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"BANK_ID": "CBANK-BOC", "NAME": "Bank of Canada", "COUNTRY": "CAN", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Canada", "CURRENCY": "CAD", "WEBSITE": "https://www.bankofcanada.ca", "POLICY_RATE": 2.5, "POLICY_RATE_DATE": "2026-11-05", "POLICY_SERIES": "CBSER-BOC-V39079", "LAST_MOVE_DATE": "2026-10-29", "LAST_MOVE_BP": 25.0, "PRESS": "PRESS-BOC"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/central-banks/contracts/central-bank.contract.yaml` ([central-banks](../../docs/contracts/packs/central-banks.md)).

### rate-series

Pack `central-banks`, kind `rate-series` (Central bank series), table `rate-series`, key `SERIES_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/central-banks/<date>/rate-series.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required | CBSER-, the source (FRED or BOC) and the source's series code with dots as underscores. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The series' title, as NAME for search. |
| `SOURCE` | text | required | The source the series is read from: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis) or the Bank of Canada. |
| `CODE` | text | required | The series' code at its source (DGS10, V39079). |
| `CENTRAL_BANK` | id | required | The central-bank page the series belongs to (CBANK-<id>). |
| `TITLE` | text | required | The series' title in the feed's YAML, else the source's own. |
| `DESCRIPTION` | text | optional | The source's description of the series (FRED's notes, the Valet description), cut at 600 characters. |
| `UNIT` | text | required | What the series measures (%, percentage points, an index, USD millions, CAD per USD). |
| `FREQUENCY` | text | optional | How often the source publishes the series, in its own words. |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | The latest observation, in the series' unit. |
| `LATEST_DATE` | date | required | The date of the latest observation. |
| `PREVIOUS` | amount | optional | The observation before the latest one. |
| `PREVIOUS_DATE` | date | optional | The date of the previous observation. |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | The latest observation less the previous one, in the series' unit. |
| `CHANGE_1Y` | amount | optional | The latest observation less the last one at least a year before it; empty when the window is shorter. |
| `HIGH` | amount | required | The highest observation in the history window. |
| `LOW` | amount | required | The lowest observation in the history window. |
| `OBSERVATIONS` | integer | required | How many observations the history holds. |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required | The observations over the window (the feed's history-days), oldest first (DATE, VALUE). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"SERIES_ID": "CBSER-BOC-AVG_INTWO", "NAME": "CORRA, Canadian overnight repo rate average", "SOURCE": "Bank of Canada", "CODE": "AVG.INTWO", "CENTRAL_BANK": "CBANK-BOC", "TITLE": "CORRA, Canadian overnight repo rate average", "DESCRIPTION": "A measure of the cost of overnight general collateral fundi…", "UNIT": "%", "FREQUENCY": "Business daily", "LATEST": 2.52, "LATEST_DATE": "2026-11-05", "PREVIOUS": 2.52, "PREVIOUS_DATE": "2026-11-04", "CHANGE": 0.0, "CHANGE_1Y": 0.25, "HIGH": 2.56, "LOW": 2.24, "OBSERVATIONS": 273}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/central-banks/contracts/rate-series.contract.yaml` ([central-banks](../../docs/contracts/packs/central-banks.md)).
